name: Start-up and wall-following cleaning in an empty room
expected: Tick 0: Direction = Forward and Clean = clean_on are written once; state FwdNormal; all stores false (C21, C22, C27).
Ticks 1-4: the RVC moves straight N from (4,4) to (4,0). No Direction or Clean is written (C12).
Tick 5: at (4,0) the wall ahead raises the front interrupt (F = true). Left is free, so the RVC turns left: Direction = Turn Left, Clean = clean_off (R3, C4, C8).
Ticks 5-7: the turn lasts 3 ticks; the heading becomes W at the end of tick 7 (C5).
Tick 8: the front interrupt reports F = false; Direction = Forward and Clean = clean_on (R3).

For the rest of the run the RVC follows the walls, turning left at every corner (3-tick turn each). It never turns right and never reverses. The right sensor is true along the walls and causes no reaction (C13).
function_text: EF-01 – Start-up outputs: Direction = Forward and Clean = clean_on sent once; stores false
EF-02 – Straight forward movement with normal cleaning (clean_on)
EF-03 – Front obstacle detection by interrupt (walls and obstacles); false only updates the store
EF-06 – Avoidance: turn left, left has priority when both sides are free
EF-08 – 3-tick turn, then resume forward with clean_on
EF-09 – Cleaning stopped (clean_off) only while turning or reversing
EF-17 – Direction and Clean are sent only when their value changes; signals only on transitions
